lines.en: Would you like to respond?
lines.zh: 要回复吗？

lines.en: What would you like to say?
lines.zh: 你想说点什么？

lines.en: : When did you take this?
lines.zh: : 你什么时候拍的这张？

lines.en: : When Maya and I were waiting for you on the roof.
lines.zh: : 就是我和 Maya 在屋顶上等你的时候。

lines.en: : We weren't really sure how to pass the time, so I decided to take some pictures while Maya was all like grrrr I'm Maya.
lines.zh: : 我们不太确定怎么打发时间，所以我就趁 Maya 在那儿「我是 Maya 我超凶」的时候拍了几张。

lines.en: : It's really weird, though! They seemed normal when I looked at them on the roof. But after we reset, the sky was gone in all of them.
lines.zh: : 不过真的很怪！在屋顶上看的时候它们还挺正常的。可我们重置之后，所有照片里的天空都不见了。

lines.en: : Do you think it means anything?
lines.zh: : 你觉得这有什么含义吗？

lines.en: : I have no idea. Have you shown it to Maya?
lines.zh: : 我不知道。你给 Maya 看过了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, but she doesn't have any idea either.
lines.zh: : 看了，她也没头绪。

lines.en: : It's the big black thing that weirds me out the most. Not a sex joke.
lines.zh: : 最让我发毛的是那个巨大的黑色东西。不是性笑话。

lines.en: : It's pretty much in the same exact spot where the moon was, but...idk. Looking at it makes me feel weird.
lines.zh: : 它基本就在月亮原来那个位置，不过……我不知道。看着它让我觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Kinda like it's watching us or something.
lines.zh: : 有点像它在看着我们什么的。

lines.en: : It certainly does have a...threatening aura to it?
lines.zh: : 它确实有种……威胁性的气场？

lines.en: : Right???
: The slumber party thing didn't really work, but maybe we can try taking more pictures next time we're up there?
lines.zh: : 睡衣派对那招没奏效，不过也许下次我们上去时可以多拍点照片？

lines.en: : Oooh, video too. We should try all sorts of stuff since doing the same thing over and over obviously hasn't worked for you guys.
lines.zh: : 哦哦，视频也拍。我们应该什么都试试——毕竟你们一遍遍做同样的事显然没用。

lines.en: : Well, I'm glad that you seem to be enjoying this.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我很高兴你似乎挺享受这个的。

lines.en: : I'm making the most of it. You should too.
lines.zh: : 我在充分利用它。你也该这样。

lines.en: : It's scary, yeah. But we have each other. And we should do everything we can to keep each other comfortable while we're up there.
lines.zh: : 是挺可怕的，没错。可我们有彼此。我们在上面的时候，应该尽一切所能让彼此舒服些。

lines.en: : Everything except having sex, that is. Since Maya doesn't want to watch us for some reason.
lines.zh: : 除了做爱之外的一切——因为 Maya 不知为什么不想看我们做。

lines.en: : I'm sure you know what that reason is, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我确信你知道那个原因是什么，Ayane。

lines.en: : Yeah, I'm sure Maya does as well. And yet...
lines.zh: : 是啊，我确信 Maya 也知道。可即便如此……

lines.en: : Okay...well, if we're not going to talk about the picture anymore, I should probably go.
lines.zh: : 好吧……那，如果我们不再聊这张照片了，我大概该走了。

lines.en: : Same. I'm actually in the bath with Sana right now.
lines.zh: : 我也是。我现在其实正跟 Sana 一起泡澡。

lines.en: : Why didn't you send me that instead?
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不发那张给我？

lines.en: : Because Sana's tiny boobies aren't going to save the world.
lines.zh: : 因为 Sana 那对小胸部救不了世界。

lines.en: : You don't know that.
lines.zh: : 这你可说不准。

lines.en: : Good point. Let's try and get her up there for the next reset.
lines.zh: : 有道理。下次重置我们想办法把她也弄上去吧。

lines.en: : I'll talk to you later, [ayanemaster]. I love you :)
lines.zh: : 回头聊，[ayanemaster]。我爱你 :)

lines.en: : I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。
